AI / Generative AI Engineer (Agentic Systems & Azure AI)

Hyderabad / Vizag / Remote

Fulltime

UK Shift: 2:30 PM - 11:30 PM IST

5-6 years experience

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled AI / Generative AI Engineer with strong experience in Python-based LLM frameworks, agentic architectures, and Azure AI services.

The ideal candidate will design, build, and deploy intelligent, autonomous AI systems using LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, and Azure ML/AI Foundry, while integrating enterprise data platforms and automation tools.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong programming experience in Python
Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph
Proven experience building agentic AI systems and tool-based reasoning workflows
Experience with Vector Databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Azure AI Search)
Working knowledge of Azure Cosmos DB
Experience with Azure Machine Learning and Azure AI Foundry
Strong understanding of RAG architectures
Experience working with Data Lakes and large-scale data pipelines
Familiarity with Zapier or similar automation/orchestration tools
Solid understanding of REST APIs, authentication, and cloud-native design
Experience with OpenAI / Azure OpenAI models
Knowledge of LLMOps / MLOps practices
Exposure to Docker, CI/CD pipelines
Experience with monitoring and evaluating LLM performance
Background in enterprise or regulated environments
